task.description:
Update the tests of REQ-070 for the corrections of the independent readers (decisions/0087; WF-02 step 5, repeated). The data files changed in steps 11, 12 and 13 of this run (42 + 6 + 1 strings, the list with was/became is in result.changes of those three handoffs): the reader's three passes ended with «да» for all 189 pairs of kk and of en. One test is now red: DT-2c, which compares the kk and en texts of the mapped paths with the sample.
Do exactly this, in tools/test/picker-demo-v3.test.js only (no data, no src, no other test; the helpers stay imported):
(1) Add the TABLE OF READER CORRECTIONS (decisions/0087 item 2) as a literal table in the test file: for each text that the readers made the file differ from the SAMPLE on a mapped path (a path of the path map of the design, section 4: the texts that come from the sample), one row: tenant, path, language (kk or en), the sample text (literal), the corrected text (literal, equal to the file now), the number of the reader's pair. Texts the executor wrote (not in the sample) are not rows: DT-2c does not compare them. Build the rows from the three handoffs and CHECK each row against the sample (the sample text at the path must equal the row's «was» of the FIRST correction of that path) and against the file now. The currency sign change («KZT» to «₸») is a row if the text is in the sample.
(2) DT-2c: ru texts of the mapped paths equal the sample except rows E1-E3 of the table of edits (unchanged); kk and en texts of the mapped paths equal the sample except (a) the rows E1-E3 and (b) the rows of the table of reader corrections, where the file must equal the corrected text word for word. Keep the ban: a text of the file that differs from the sample without being in a table is red; a row whose corrected text does not equal the file is red; a row whose sample text does not equal the sample is red; a row for a ru text is impossible (assert no row has language ru). The table has no more rows than the number of changed pairs (assert the count equals the literal number you build). The table of edits stays at six rows at most (assert it).
(3) Mutants for the new logic, applied one at a time on a scratch copy of tools/ (session scratchpad folder named in the launching message; restore the file from the live tree after each run; sequentially; no git checkout/reset/stash/clean, also not in scratch copies): a kk text changed without a row; a row whose corrected text differs from the file by one letter; a row whose sample text is wrong; a ru text corrected; a seventh row of the table of edits; a row removed (the file then differs from the sample); the table with a duplicated path. Each must make DT-2c (or another named test) red. Also re-run three mutants of the earlier set that touch DT-2c/DT-2d (MU17, MU18, MU29) to prove they are still killed.
(4) Put the mutant table in result.self_check. Then `cd tools && npm run check` once: zero red; tests 2065 (no new test is required; if you add a test, say why and give the new number); format:check, lint, traces and handoffs-check green; the sha256 over the sorted per-file sha256 list of tools/src (data folders included) equal at start and end. In your handoff text never list project names or machine paths (say "the traces list"). 16 GB RAM computer: single commands.

issues.text: Pair 99 (agency, look.team[0].role, en) is a row that follows the table of edits: E2 had changed the sample text 'reception' to 'client reception' (reason SEP), and the reader then corrected it to 'customer intake'. The first 'was' of that path in step 11 is therefore the E2 text, not the sample text. The row carries 'after: E2' and its sample text is the 'became' of E2; DT-2c checks that link (the sample equals 'was' of E2, the row's sample text equals 'became' of E2, the file equals the corrected text). E2 itself is unchanged and its ru and kk texts are still compared with 'became'. If ORCH prefers another form, say so; the other 15 rows are plain.
